title: tool_util: add Unicode support to `tool_execpath()`
body:
To fix opening `.curlrc`/`_curlrc` next to the curl tool, and to make
the CA safe search built-time option find `curl-ca-bundle.crt` as
expected when the curl tool resides on a non-ASCII path when using
a Unicode-enabled build.

The CA safe search build-time option is disabled by default. The issue 
has been discovered while working on enabling it by default.

Follow-up to d40f4e15e73f906cd06919da84e535f52637c1a1
Follow-up to 78882e46429e05c2a258a5440f06644f588cc224

Cherry-picked from #23277

---

https://github.com/curl/curl/pull/23287/files?w=1

Tested on Win11 (with OS UTF-8 CP disabled).
